user.title: Manual Location
user.description: Set a PIN of 4–12 characters: letters A–Z, a–z or digits to unlock the administrator map settings. There is no default PIN.

error.invalid_pin: Enter a PIN containing 4–12 characters: letters A–Z, a–z or digits.

init.title: Optional place and address search
init.description: Enter your Geoapify Free API key to enable search. Search text is sent to Geoapify only after Search or Enter. The Free plan has usage limits and no availability guarantee. A blank key keeps the current setting; check Remove to disable search. Manual maps and saving work without a key.

data.geoapify_api_key: Geoapify API key (leave blank to keep)
data.remove_api_key: Remove the saved key and disable search

gateway.title: Independent location gateway
gateway.description: Connect the installed gateway for the protected person. This does not enable GPS. Use the private address and secret generated during gateway setup.

error.invalid_api_key: Enter 16–128 ASCII letters, digits, underscores or hyphens, or leave this field blank.
error.invalid_gateway: Check the private loopback address, person entity and gateway secret.
